description: This Java class implements a MediaBrowserService that provides media browsing capabilities, manages media playback, and interacts with notifications and media session for a music player app. It handles media loading, playback control, session updates, and user commands.

classes.name: MusicService
classes.description: Implements a media browsing and playback service for an Android music app, handling media session, media loading, playback control, and notifications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes media provider, media session, and playback. Sets up session callback, activity, and notification manager.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming intents for playback commands like pause, and manages service lifecycle.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases resources, stops playback, and releases media session.

methods.name: onGetRoot
methods.description: Defines the root media item for media browsing, checks caller authorization.

methods.name: onLoadChildren
methods.description: Provides child media items for a given media ID, asynchronously retrieves media catalog if needed.

methods.name: loadChildrenImpl
methods.description: Loads specific media items based on parent media ID.

methods.name: handlePlayRequest
methods.description: Starts playback of the current media in queue, ensures service and session are active.

methods.name: handlePauseRequest
methods.description: Pauses media playback and schedules delayed service stop.

methods.name: handleStopRequest
methods.description: Stops playback and releases resources, schedules service delayed stop.

methods.name: updateMetadata
methods.description: Updates media session metadata with current track info, including album art.

methods.name: updatePlaybackState
methods.description: Updates the playback state, including current position, error messages, and queue info.

methods.name: setCustomAction
methods.description: Adds custom actions to playback state, such as favorite toggle.

methods.name: getAvailableActions
methods.description: Calculates available user actions based on current playback state and queue.

methods.name: getCurrentPlayingMusic
methods.description: Retrieves metadata of the current playing track.

methods.name: onCompletion
methods.description: Callback for when media playback completes; proceeds to next in queue or stops.

methods.name: onPlaybackStatusChanged
methods.description: React to playback state changes, update UI/state.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during playback, updates playback state accordingly.

methods.name: DelayedStopHandler
methods.description: Inner class handler that stops the service if playback is not active after delay.
